name: KromiumException
declaration: sealed class KromiumException(@JvmField val errorCode: KromiumErrorCode, @JvmField val isRecoverable: Boolean, override val message: String, override val cause: Throwable? = null) : RuntimeException(message, cause)
description: Sealed exception hierarchy for all Kromium-specific errors. Provides an errorCode and isRecoverable flag for robust programmatic error handling and recovery.
whenToUse: Catch KromiumException or its typed subclasses when initializing the engine, configuring proxies, running JavaScript evaluations, exporting PDFs, or creating OSR browser canvases.

properties.name: errorCode
properties.description: Standardized error code classification for programmatic handling and telemetry.

properties.name: isRecoverable
properties.description: Indicates whether the operation can be retried (true) or is a fatal state (false).

properties.name: message
properties.description: Human-readable diagnostic message explaining the cause of the failure.
